build.energy_regen_target: 120% minimum (to keep Liberation available in her rotation)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Azure Oath (or Emerald of Genesis / Lumingloss) + 5-piece Song of Feathered Trace in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Thousand-Puppet Pavilion in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Havoc DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, a ~70:250 Crit balance, and 120% Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Azure Oath
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature; tailor-made for her Havoc Bane Heavy Attack kit. Best in slot.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner sword; Crit Rate, ATK%, and Energy Regen make it her best general alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss
ranked_weapons.note: Limited 5-star alternative; strong ATK-based passive that synergizes with Heavy Attacks.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: BP 4-star; ATK% and strong general buffs on Intro Skill. Great F2P pick.

stat_priorities.note: Crit 4-cost; balance toward a ~70:250 Crit ratio.
Havoc DMG on both; ATK% is a workable substitute.

profile.role_note: Havoc Bane hypercarry; deals most of her damage through Heavy Attacks and self-buffs that scale with Bane stacks.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: One of the strongest DPS units in the game and the premier Havoc Bane carry; SS overall on the 3.7 tier list. Worth pulling if you want a top-tier Havoc DPS, though she wants Chisa and Suisui around her to unlock her full potential.

members.name: Yangyang Xuanling
members.note: The Havoc Bane hypercarry; huge DMG multipliers and self-buffs that max out with Chisa's stack-cap increase.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Increases the max stack limit of Havoc Bane by 3, unlocking Yangyang's innate passives; provides DEF ignore and healing.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: All DMG amplification, team ATK boost, DEF and Havoc RES ignore, plus off-field healing.

members.name: Yangyang Xuanling

members.name: Mornye
members.note: All-Type DMG amplification, healing, and faster Tune Break triggers.

teams.name: Alternative: Yangyang Xuanling + Lynae + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye sets up buffs and sustain, Lynae drops her general DMG window, then Yangyang runs her standard Bane-stack-and-detonate rotation.

Shadow summon on Flow plus interruption immunity — the comfort fix.
+100% Heavy Attack DMG plus out-of-combat resets — the clean stopping point.
+175% Liberation amplification and +3 Havoc Bane cap — her nuke node.
Voice Flux plus guaranteed-crit shadow summons off teammate debuffs.
